# IPTV Mexico

> IPTV Mexico is a subscription IPTV service built specifically around Mexican television — Liga MX league matches, Selección Mexicana national-team coverage, Mexican novelas, and Mexican regional news and entertainment channels — carried alongside the same full English-language and international catalog every plan includes, not in place of it. A meaningful share of the real audience is Mexican households and fans living in the United States who want Liga MX and Mexican TV without a Mexican cable subscription; nothing about ordering, activation, or watching requires a Mexican address. Plans include 40,000+ live channels and 180,000+ VOD titles, identical across every plan length — a longer term lowers the price, it never unlocks extra content. Subscriptions run 1, 3, 6, or 12 months ($14.99 / $34.99 / $54.99 / $79.99 USD), with a $1.00 24-hour trial available before committing, running the identical live catalog a paying subscriber gets. Compatible with Smart TVs, Android TV, Fire TV, Android and iOS devices, Apple TV, Windows, and macOS.
